text: Gelooɗi ɗin e na'i ɗin, ɗin neldaaɗi Suudu ndun Men waɗanii on ɗi jeyaaɗi e so'irteeɗi Diina kan e maandeeji makka ɗin, no woodani on e majji nafa diinayankoha e adunayankoha, wi'ii: (Bismillaahi) tuma boragol ɗi ɓaawo ɗi saffinii darorɗe majji hara hiɗi darii no haɓɓaa gootal e koyɗe yeesooje majji ɗen fii wata ɗi saako, siɗi fukkike ɓaawo boragol ngol e dow ɓabbe majji, ñaamee -onon nelduɓe ɓen- immorde e majji, okkoron ɓilliiɗo nanntiiɗo on e toragol, e ɓilliiɗo weeɓitotooɗo fii yo o okkore e ɗum, ko wano Men eltirani on ɗi nii fii yo on ronndin ɗi waɗɗoɗon ɗi Men eltirani on ɗi, ɗi ɗoftii haa nokku ka borotoɗon ɗi ɗon; ɓattorɗum Alla belejo'o onon on yettay Alla e dow neema eltanngol on ɗi ngol.
